fleet.heading: Fleet
fleet.lede: All connected VPS agents and their backup footprint.

locked.title: Multi-VPS fleet is a Business feature
locked.body: Upgrade to the Business plan to register agents on additional servers and see your whole fleet in one place.

empty.title: No agents yet
empty.hint: Register an agent on another VPS to see it here.

errors.rotate: Could not rotate the agent key.

dialog.title: Register agent
dialog.description: Add a VPS to your fleet. The agent authenticates with the API key generated below.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.hostHint: The hostname or IP address of the machine you're adding as an agent.
dialog.portHint: Optional — defaults to 22 (the standard SSH port) if left blank.
dialog.keyWarning: This API key is shown once and can never be retrieved again. Copy it now.
dialog.installIntro: Run this on the machine you're adding. It starts the Dockstash agent container with the token baked in.

setup.title: Agent setup
setup.description: Install command and key management for this agent.
setup.keyPlaceholderNote: Replace <AGENT_TOKEN> with the token from registration. The token can't be shown again — if you lost it, rotate the key below.

rotate.title: Rotate agent key
rotate.description: A new token is generated and the old one stops working immediately. You must update the agent with the new token.

remove.title: Remove agent
remove.description: Remove "{{name}}" from your fleet? Its projects fall back to local backups and any queued jobs are cancelled.
